lexicalDecisions.decision: One necessary new准教授じゅんきょうじゅ article, noun associate professor, supports exactジュン. Family also recognizes準教授 with no rare-spelling flag; do not label it nonexistent, or infer official/current preferred spelling from dictionary order alone. Selected primary identity is准教授, supported by exact public Japanese rank entries. Actual助教授 article cannot be relabelled or reused as the same primary word.

Military/nobility rank families confirm the rank-prefix branch. Country/system-specific English equivalents are not a universal rank ladder. No extra articles are required; do not teach semi- as an arithmetic half or a blanket exact English translation for every title.

准許 approval/sanction,批准 ratification and批准書 instrument of ratification preserve a separate authorization branch. Brief批准ひじゅん recognition prevents a universal associate-rank claim. No new批准 support article is necessary for the single selected reading.

准看 is an abbreviation,准看護婦 has explicit now-deprecated sense note, and准看護師 gives assistant/practical nurse. Do not adopt the deprecated female title as a current neutral teaching example just because the character dictionary lists it. No nursing article or universal qualification claim.

准える,准じる,准ずる,准拠,に准じて and准州 are rare-kanji variants in these exact families. なずらえる is separately rare kana,なぞらえる usually kana, and順じる/順ずる are search-only. Preserve sense-local notes, including準ずる's occ. as順ずる; do not silently erase the distinct raw annotation. These do not license arbitrary准/準 swaps or new frozen kun readings.
準教員/准教員 is a historical assistant-teacher title explicitly dated1886-1946 in the frozen sense. Not an ordinary current准教授 synonym.
準行/准行 means following a standard or precedent. Recognition evidence of the relationship, not an extra necessary article or a general spelling-substitution rule.
准胝観音/准提観音 is a Buddhist proper religious expression withじゅんでいかんのん. Specialist identity is not a useful new everyday practice example or an occasion to infer missing name readings.

comparisonDecisions.decision: 教授 has professor noun and separate transitive teaching/instructionする sense;准教授 is a rank noun, not automatically aする employment verb. 助教 is assistant professor;助教授 has assistant/associate English glosses but actual article qualifies the former Japanese title. Direct准教授/助教授 quiz guard proposed from explicit same gloss and predecessor history, not a claim of free current interchangeability.

教員 identifies teaching staff; actual先生せんせい is broader teacher/address with respectful, jocular and archaic branches. Keep unrelated rareシーサン and archaicせんじょう/せんしょう/ぜんじょう families separate; same spelling is not another primary reading for the existing article. A specific准教授 appointment does not make every use of先生 that rank.

Actual準備じゅんび and基準/規準きじゅん are independently documented spellings and meanings. Do not mechanically replace準 by准 or claim quasi/associate is every準 meaning. Existing準 card already has three curated distractors, so no established default-four-choice repair.

承認 recognition/approval/consent is not a general rank noun;批准 is ratification. Character准's permission branch is supported but no new overlapping approval word title is introduced. 批准 intentionally repeats the lexical packet:37 family occurrences,36 distinct.

rolesDecisions.decision: Actual教師 teacher/instructor and講師 lecturer/instructor have broader or different role meanings and direct existing safeguards with先生. A shared university setting is not sufficient to make every academic title interchangeable or form a new exclusion clique. Final quiz labels still need independent review.

助手じょしゅ includes general helper and professor/research assistant senses. Separate助け手/助手たすけて/すけて family remains complete but does not replace the actual primaryじょしゅ article. Do not define准教授 as a professor's personal assistant.
